resources.string: Low latency prioritizes responsiveness. When audio is available, synchronized playback delays video to align with audio, adding viewing latency. Prefer it for watching rather than fast interaction.
Automatic preserves the current codec default. Select a preset, then tune from 20 to 250 ms. Larger buffers may smooth audio but add latency. This setting is kept when audio forwarding is off.
Used only in synchronized mode. Positive values delay video further; negative values reduce video delay. Range: \u2212200 to +200 ms. Switching modes keeps this adjustment.
Off by default. Retry lost connections a limited number of times with increasing delays. Leaving the mirroring screen or canceling stops retries.
Saved playback and reconnect changes take effect when you next connect or reconnect.
